newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Liu Chong Hing completes US$80 mln FRCD.
newsitem.headline: Liu Chong Hing completes US$80 mln FRCD.

text.p: Liu Chong Hing Bank's US$80 million floating rate certificates of deposit issue has been successfully completed, arranger Citicorp International said on Monday.
The certificates carry a maturity of five years with a put option in year three. They were issued at par to float at 40 basis points over the six-month London Interbank Offered Rate.
With fees, the all-in return for top-tier managers is 50.42 basis points.
Arrangers and lead managers are Bayerische Landesbank Hong Kong branch, Citicorp International, Standard Chartered Bank, Westdeutsche Landesbank Hong Kong branch and Westpac Banking Corp.
Co-lead managers are Australia and New Zealand Banking Group, and Tokai Asia.
Senior managers are Banca Nazionale del Lavoro SpA Hong Kong branch, Banque Francaise du Commerce Exterieur and Royal Bank of Scotland.
Managers are Dah Sing Bank, Union Bank of California International Banking Facility and Ka Wah Bank.
Signing is set for December 20. The payment date is December 23. -- Hong Kong Newsroom (852) 2843 6960
